noah: heads-up: saw a regression pattern where demote tombstones and prefix handoffs interact and cause prolonged cold rehydrates for a tenant (eu-west). digging in. tara: can you paste the minimal timeline? that pool has been noisy. noah: sure. simplified: T1 demote writes a tombstone (old flow: tombstone has no owner/gen) T2 handoff reads residency; sees non-resident -> proceeds to takeover and nukes in-mem caches T3 GC later removes tombstone, another agent thinks prefix empty and rehydrates -> thrash sam: sounds like the core issue is tombstones are indistinguishable from legitimate demote intent vs ephemeral markers. handoff needs more context. maya: RFC hinted at owner metadata but didn't land it. we should add tombstone_owner + tombstone_gen + reason. that allows handoff to decide deterministically whether to respect the tombstone. noah: propose lightweight approach: writer (demote) CASes residency.generation and writes tombstone with owner/gen. handoff checks tombstone.owner/gen and if it's recent and matches expected owner, treat as valid demote -> skip takeover. otherwise treat as transient and verify. tara: advantage: minimal change to read path (only an extra check) and safer. downside storage overhead and added CAS on demote path. sam: implement CAS guard so only the current owner can emit a tombstone representing its own demote. prevents accidental/malicious blocking. also emit metric `tombstone_write_cas_fail`. noah: rollout plan: write-only migration (accept optional fields) -> enable handoff checks behind flag `kvcache.check_tombstone_owner` -> run chaos test `kvcache/tombstone-owner-chaos` in staging for 24h -> canary -> global. ci-bot: queued job: kvcache/tombstone-owner-chaos (5 iterations). tara: add runbook note: if we see increased cold-miss after enabling, toggle flag per-cluster and run `tools/kv/force_prefix_quiesce --pool --prefix

`. also add an alert `tombstone_owner_mismatch > 5 in 5m`. sam: tests: unit tests for proto schema, chaos that races demote+handoff, perf smoke to measure storage increase, and integration to assert no cold-miss regression. include CAS retry backoff so hot prefixes don't amplify. maya: small implementation nit: tombstone.reason should be enum (DEMOTE_ADMIN, DEMOTE_AUTOMATIC, MANUAL_CLEAR) so ops can filter. and TTL GC should consult tombstone_gen vs current_epoch with grace window. noah: agree. I'll open the PR with schema + CAS writer + metrics + feature flag. ETA 48h. will include snippet for txn cond: `expected = { owner: O, gen: G, tombstone: null }; new = { owner: null, gen: G, tombstone: { owner: O, gen: G, reason: DEMOTE_AUTOMATIC, ts: now } }` ci-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/kvcache/pull/452 (tombstone owner metadata + CAS) tara: thanks. once in staging let's run the chaos job and watch `kv_prefix_latency_p95` and `tombstone_write_cas_fail`. sam: ack. I'll help with correctness docs in the PR. maya: ping @oncall-eng-runtime if you see >2% cold-miss regression within 15m after enabling.
